## Dental implants

They are an effective and long-lasting solution for replacing missing teeth, designed to integrate naturally into your mouth.

**We work with the best brands: Straumann®, Nobel Biocare®, and Neodent®.**

[![Image 10](https://joyadent.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/ico06.png)](https://joyadent.com/nuestros%20tratamientos/#brackets)

## Brackets

An effective solution for correcting dental misalignment and malocclusions. It helps realign your teeth, improving not only the aesthetics of your smile but also your oral health.

**Metal braces, ceramic braces, sapphire braces, orthopedic appliances, and myofunctional retainers.**

[![Image 11](https://joyadent.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/ico01.png)](https://joyadent.com/nuestros%20tratamientos/#manchas)

## Dental cleaning and whitening

Remove plaque and tartar, preventing diseases and improving oral health. Teeth whitening transforms your smile by removing stains and discoloration for a radiant shine.

**We offer two types of whitening: in-office treatments and take-home trays.**

## Dental crowns and resin fillings

Crowns protect and strengthen weakened teeth, while resin fillings provide aesthetic repair.

Zirconia, ceramic, and porcelain metal. We can replace old amalgam restorations with a more biocompatible and aesthetic material like composite resin.

[![Image 19](https://joyadent.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/ico07.png)](https://joyadent.com/en/our-treatments/#periodontalingles)

## Periodontal Treatments

Fundamental for combating gum diseases and maintaining oral health. It helps prevent tooth loss.

Members of the Mexican Board of Periodontology with over 10 years of experience.

### ORHODONTICS

Orthodontics is much more than just aligning teeth; it is a treatment that significantly improves oral health and functionality. By correcting the position of the teeth, an aesthetic and harmonious smile is achieved that also enhances facial symmetry. Additionally, properly aligned teeth allow for more effective dental hygiene, as eliminating crowding or excessive spaces makes it easier to clean all surfaces of the teeth, thus reducing the risk of cavities and gum problems. Another key benefit of orthodontics is bite correction. A proper bite is essential for performing basic functions such as chewing and speaking correctly, preventing discomfort or long-term issues in the jaw joints. Furthermore, optimal alignment and bite contribute to preventing premature wear on the teeth.

### TREATMENT "All on 4 - All on 6"

The All On 4 and All On 6 dental treatments are revolutionary methods for replacing lost teeth. Patients often ask us what All On 4 is and how it differs from conventional implant procedures. All On 4 is a dental implant technique in which the entire upper or lower set of teeth is replaced with just four implants. These four implants serve as the support mechanism for placing a new set of fixed teeth. In the All On 4 implant procedure, the posterior implants are tilted 45° towards the back of the mouth and placed in the anterior maxilla, an area of the jaw with denser bone. Compared to other implant methods, the All On 4 technique doesn't require the same bone density to securely anchor the implant.

### WE HAVE ADVANCED TECHNOLOGY

The intraoral camera is an advanced tool in dentistry that allows for detailed images of the inside of the mouth in real-time. This device, similar to a small camera, is introduced into the oral cavity and captures high-resolution photographs or videos of the teeth, gums, and other structures. Thanks to the intraoral camera, we can detect problems that are difficult to observe with the naked eye, such as small cavities, cracks in the teeth, gum inflammation, or early signs of oral diseases. Additionally, the images captured are projected onto a screen, allowing the patient to clearly and directly see the condition of their mouth and better understand the treatment recommendations.
